community.reason: Level 3: external education and community investment with substantial measured reach, including NT$5.31 million in scholarships, NT$2.56 million for rural reading programs, 4,536 volunteer hours and NT$13.17 million raised for the Social Caring Fund, though none of it is central to strategy.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current activities with limited reach and no reach figures, namely volunteer support for visually impaired students and gender-equality training, beyond demographic disclosures.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the filing shows only the company's own innovation and R&D, rests on general language, and has no specific program enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: The Shareholder Letter also cites sponsorship of the documentary Beyond Beauty: Taiwan from Above III, Dr. Rednose hospital performances and visual storytelling camps for rural students; these are treated as part of the E1 cultural investment and not counted twice. The 2026 targets (cultural investment exceeding NTD 3 million, scholarships exceeding NT$4.8 million, 18 volunteer sessions) are planned and were not scored. Board gender balance (4 of 8 directors female) and the 18.90% female workforce are demographics only. Purchasing from local small farmers, sheltered workshops and social-innovation enterprises (procurement awards) was not counted as enabling entrepreneurship. Two items were noted but not scored separately: support for the employment of people with disabilities and gender-friendly areas, described only in a long list sentence. A director's outside roles at TEN Incubation and TEN Angel Investment are not company activities.
